adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `updateEvent` now sets `selectedCalendar` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the else branch), the `.find()` compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is `undefined/null`, so it will almost always return `undefined`, making `selectedCalendar` undefined. The same pattern is used in `deleteEvent` (`calendarId` computed via `.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` in the falsy branch). This breaks the intended fallback-to-destination-calendar behavior for cases where `externalCalendarId` is missing (e.g., legacy references), and can cause updates/deletes to target the wrong calendar (falling back to default/primary depending on later code).
